items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 16 August 2026 12:03pm
items.description:
##Today##

Largely cloudy and often dry, just a few outbreaks of light rain until about mid-morning and again this evening / early tonight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-1


##Wind Speed##

12


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

Variable 10 or less, settling mainly W or SW 10-15 late morning, then backing S or SW late afternoon, occasionally touching 20 this evening, veering W or NW overnight.


##Visibility##

Generally good. Isolated hill fog patches at first & again overnight.


##Comments##

Nil.
